question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Vain
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Productive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Therefore, the correct **antonym** for **"vain"** is **"productive."** 
 
• **"Vain"** refers to something lacking substance or value (व्यर्थ)
 
• **"productive" **implies being capable of producing results or being successful in achieving desired outcomes. (उत्पादक)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Productive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the other options:
 
 
• **Harmony:** This word refers to a state of agreement, cooperation, or peaceful coexistence between different elements or individuals.( समरसता)
 
• **Unpredictable: **This word describes something that cannot be easily foreseen or anticipated, lacking predictability or consistency.(अप्रत्याशित)
 
• **Calculable: **This word means something that can be determined or estimated with certainty or accuracy. (हिसाब लगाने योग्य)
